name: yucapass-github-flat
description: YucaPass 5.0 — edición profesional, una sola fuente web/Android y preparación de publicación Google Play.

scripts.android:add: npm run build:web && cap add android && npm run android:prepare
scripts.android:sync: npm run build:web && cap sync android && npm run android:prepare
scripts.android:debug: npm run android:sync && cd android && ./gradlew assembleDebug
scripts.check: npm run test:reservations && npm run check:supabase-config && npm run test:roles && npm run test:analytics-stamps && npm run test:syntax && npm run test:auth && npm run test:hotel-onboarding && npm run test:unified && npm run test:release-config && npm run test:pwa
scripts.android:release: npm run android:sync && node scripts/configure-release-signing.mjs && cd android && ./gradlew bundleRelease
